visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a long braid, wearing a vintage-style yellow floral top with a white lace collar and a matching wide-brimmed hat, stands in a bathroom. She looks down and meticulously adjusts the waist of her pinkish-orange floral skirt. The background features white-tiled walls, a white sink with a purple soap bottle, and a yellow floral robe on a heated towel rack. (2) She turns her head to the right to look into a large wall-mounted mirror. Her reflection shows her smiling broadly with bright eyes, clearly pleased with her appearance. She reaches up to touch her hat while maintaining a joyful facial expression. The lighting is even and bright from overhead indoor fixtures. (3) The woman turns her entire body toward the camera, her mouth open in a wide, happy smile. She moves her hands excitedly near her chest, showcasing the details of the dress. The camera is held at an eye-level, slightly shaky handheld position, capturing her full upper body and head. (4) In a moment of heightened emotion, she brings both hands up to cover her mouth and nose. Her eyes are crinkled in a squinted, joyful expression, suggesting shock or disbelief. She stands on white bath mats placed on the dark-tiled bathroom floor. (5) She looks down at the fabric of her skirt again, smoothing it out with her palms. Her movements are quick and energetic. She then begins to jump up and down rhythmically, her long brown braid bouncing against her back and shoulders. (6) Facing the mirror once more, she uses both hands to adjust the long fabric ties of her hat under her chin. She then pivots back to the camera, tilting her head playfully and resting her chin on her hand in a classic posing gesture. (7) She laughs heartily, her shoulders shaking, and covers her mouth once more. After one final exuberant jump, she leans her face directly into the camera lens, puckering her lips in an exaggerated kissing motion, momentarily blurring the image due to proximity.
